hero.title: From first look to first hello.
hero.text: Adoption starts with learning about the cats and sharing a little about your home. Here is a closer look at the process.

steps.title: A thoughtful way to find your match.

items.title: Browse the cats
items.text: Start with the current listings. Read each profile for the cat’s personality and any important notes.

items.title: Keep an open mind
items.text: You can express interest in a particular cat or begin the process while you are still deciding. Some bonded cats need a home together.

items.title: Submit an application
items.text: Share information about your household and what you hope for in a companion. Applicants must be at least 18.

items.title: Connect with the team
items.text: Volunteers review your application and may follow up with questions or talk through potential matches. Availability can change while applications are being reviewed.

items.title: Meet, if appropriate
items.text: After approval, a meet-and-greet can be arranged. Cats live in foster homes, so visits are coordinated in advance.

items.title: Discuss next steps
items.text: If it feels like a good match, the team will explain the remaining adoption steps and answer your questions.

finish.title: Your next companion might be waiting.
finish.text: Explore the current cats, then use the official application when you are ready to connect.
